gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 3730.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Cotton Tree Drive running eastward for a distance of approximately 270 metres as shown coloured pink in Drawing No. HH 3719. Proposed Name: DRAKE STREET. Chinese Version: 德立街.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路位置在 HH 3719 號圖則上以粉紅色標明，起點與紅棉路連接，向東伸展約二百七十米。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 3730.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Harcourt Road running southward for a distance of approximately 110 metres and terminating at its junction with Queensway as shown coloured pink hatched black in Drawing No. HH 3719. Proposed Name: RODNEY STREET. Chinese Version: 樂禮街.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路位置在 HH 3719 號圖則上以粉紅色加黑色影線標明，起點與夏慤道連接，向南伸展約一百一十米，在連接金鐘道處終結。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 3730.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Queensway running northward for a distance of approximately 90 metres and terminating at its junction with Harcourt Road as shown coloured pink cross hatched black in Drawing No. HH 3719. Proposed Name: TAMAR STREET. Chinese Version: 添馬街.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路位置在 HH 3719 號圖則上以粉紅色加黑色十字影線標明，起點與金鐘道連接，向北伸展九十米，在連接夏慤道處終結。
